A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
Range-Net can extract the singular values and singular vectors at machine precision, while satisfying the Eckart-Young Mirsky (EYM)-tail-energy lower bound.
Range-Net extracts the rank-$r$ singular values and vectors at machine precision with memory requirement independent of the sample size.
Range-Net extracts a rank-$r$, low tail-energy approximation of a data matrix at machine precision, with low memory requirements, and is fully interpretable.
The main takeaway from our work is that
Range-Net can be used as a low memory replacement of rank-$r$ matrix factorization in Big Data applications.
Range-Net can be used as an alternative to SVD when computing a rank-$k$ approximation to a large matrix is required.
